instruction.text: Find the messy desk in the back row.
Find two things on the desk made of this material.

feedback.end: Wood is a sturdy building material and is easy to shape with tools into other things, like this pencil and ruler.
People use soft woven fabric for things like clothing, blankets and bags. Fabric can also be used to dry things that are wet.
When metal is heated up to high temperatures it can be reshaped into other things, like this can. Metal is strong, holds heat well and can be sharpened to create cutting tools like these scissors.
Many things, such as this water bottle and lunch box, are made from plastic because it is light and easy to make into all sorts of different shapes, sizes and colours.

instruction.text: Find two things on the teacher’s desk made of this material.

feedback.end: Paper is great for writing and drawing on because it holds ink and colour well. This is why books and newspapers are made from it.
Things like cups and fish bowls are made of glass because you can see through it. Imagine a fish bowl made of wood. You wouldn’t be able to see the fish at all!

text: Here is an example of what things made of clay might look like.

feedback.end: Clay is shaped and then baked in a hot oven, where it hardens into a stronger ceramic. It is used for things like bricks, cups and bowls and can hold heat very well.
